title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 12
paragraphs: So they prepared their plot, and when night came — for Gyges was not allowed to leave, and there was no way out for him but to kill or be killed — he followed the woman into the bedchamber. She gave him a dagger and hid him behind that same door. Then, while Candaules was sleeping, Gyges came on him secretly, killed him, and took both the woman and the kingdom. The Parian poet Archilochus, who lived about that time, mentioned him in an iambic trimeter verse.
